title: Binary Search Trees (BST)
markdown:
### Binary Search Trees (BST)

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 780 228" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title>Binary Search Tree: one key per node, left and right children</title>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="778" height="226" rx="10" fill="var(--nodal-svg-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="1.6"/>
<text x="390" y="27" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)">Binary Search Tree</text><line x1="390" y1="87" x2="220" y2="148" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><line x1="390" y1="87" x2="560" y2="148" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-border)" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/><circle cx="390" cy="70" r="21" fill="var(--nodal-svg-accent-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="390" y="75" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)">20</text><circle cx="220" cy="167" r="21" fill="var(--nodal-svg-accent-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="220" y="172" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)">10</text><circle cx="560" cy="167" r="21" fill="var(--nodal-svg-accent-surface)" stroke="var(--nodal-svg-accent)" stroke-width="1.8"/><text x="560" y="172" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="600" fill="var(--nodal-svg-text)">30</text><text x="220" y="209" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="500" fill="var(--nodal-svg-muted)">left < root</text><text x="560" y="209" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-weight="500" fill="var(--nodal-svg-muted)">right > root</text>
</svg>
```
